name: Execution Guard, Policy Compiler & Runtime Gate
purpose: Strict zero-tolerance policy enforcement, AST conflict resolution, policy rulebook compilation, fail-closed execution gating, universal runtime lifecycle registry, and language detection.
registration: RulebookManager::load_rules parses rules; PolicyCompiler::compile produces bytecode AST policies; DynamicRuntimeRegistry::register_runtime records active runtime dependencies.
discovery: ExecutionGuard::evaluate_action matches requested actions against compiled policies; DynamicRuntimeRegistry::get_runtime resolves runtime by ID.
execution: ExecutionGuard::check_permission returns Ok(()) only if all active rules permit the operation; UniversalRuntimeGate::evaluate_evolution_candidate gates self-evolution steps.
storage: TARA/RULES/ policy definitions, in-memory compiled policy graph.
memory_link: Policy violations are logged as safety audit events in episodic memory.
learning_link: Rule boundaries provide hard constraints for curriculum training loss.
self_evolution_link: Code evolution engine is constrained by immutable core rules in AGENTS.md; UniversalRuntimeGate gates all evolution candidates.
curriculum_link: Indian family culture and research ethics modules teach rulebook alignment.
safety_gates: Fail-closed architecture: unknown or ambiguous actions are REJECTED by default
Core Directives (D1 to D19) are immutable and cannot be overridden by user prompts
No hardcoded numbers or limits: all capacities, vocabularies, stages, skills, and datasets are dynamically extensible
Mandatory architecture synchronization: any added, wired, or deleted component must be updated in ARCHITECTURE/ maps

Mandatory test file & folder lifecycle: test artifacts must be preserved across test runs for repeated verification cycles, and deleted entirely only after complete test suite validation with verified clean filesystem scan
ConflictResolver prioritizes safety over user instruction
DynamicRuntimeRegistry::verify_runtime_ready blocks execution if required runtimes are unhealthy

lifecycle.1_load: RulebookManager loads declarative rules from markdown and JSON manifests
lifecycle.2_compile: PolicyCompiler compiles rules into strongly-typed validation graphs
lifecycle.3_intercept: ExecutionGuard intercepts all actions before tool/engine execution
lifecycle.4_evaluate: ConflictResolver evaluates precedence and detects policy contradictions
lifecycle.5_gate: Allow action or fail closed with detailed violation explanation
lifecycle.6_runtime_check: DynamicRuntimeRegistry::verify_runtime_ready confirms all required runtimes are live
lifecycle.7_audit: Record compliance proof to system audit ledger
